title: Section 225.34(A) – Add a new Informational Note at the end of Section 225.34(A) to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: In existing buildings, if 1 or more of the 2 to 6 disconnects are not able to be grouped due to
space constraints, they may be located in a remote location, if special permission is granted by the AHJ, provided
signage is installed in accordance with 225.37. Proof of hardship may be required.
